newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares rebound slightly by close.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares rebound slightly by close.

text.p: The Jakarta stock index rebounded slightly by the close on Friday on the back of bargain hunting in heavyweight Telkom and several medium-sized counters, including banking stocks, brokers said.
The composite index rose 1.51 points, or 0.25 percent, to close at 613.01 points after touching a low of 610.69. Gainers led losers 52 to 41, with 63 counters unchanged.
Brokers said the market was likely to be mixed on Monday with possible bargain-hunting in a few big- and medium-capitalised stocks as prices were at good levels.

"The market will continue undergoing a consolidation phase after sharp rises in the index recently, but I believe the index will be around the 600-point level with support from selective foreign buying," a foreign broker said.
Brokers said sentiment would not be as strong as last Monday when Bank BNI was listed because the market was focussing on a series of five or six Initial Public Offerings in December.
Bank BNI topped the active list with 16.3 million shares changing hands, but it traded unchanged at 1,175 rupiah.
"Buying interest in the stock remains high, but the upside level appears to be limited after it rose about 47 percent since it was listed last Monday," a local broker said.
Heavyweight Telkom rose 50 rupiah to 3,875 on a turnover of 944,000 shares on bargain hunting, brokers said.

Banking stocks including Bank Modern, Bank Danamon, BDNI and Bank Niaga were among gainers on bargain hunting and also benefited from positive sentiment in the banking sector on the back of the Bank BNI listing, brokers said.
Bank Modern rose 100 rupiah to 1,750 on a volume of 2.8 million, while Bank Danamon was up 75 rupiah to 2,250 on 553,500 shares. --- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
